purpose: Source control plane for NFL intelligence. Coverage and point-in-time integrity are separate from angle desirability.

status_vocabulary.AUDITED: Repository has explicit source audit/provenance evidence for stated use.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Some repository evidence exists; contract incomplete for intended use.
status_vocabulary.PROSPECTIVE_ONLY: Usable only from captured future snapshots unless a legitimate historical archive is established.
status_vocabulary.REAUDIT_REQUIRED: Previously referenced source must be rechecked before new modeling use.
status_vocabulary.RIGHTS_OR_COST_REVIEW: Potentially useful but access/licensing/cost must be resolved.
